character: Ziggy and Ernie Leach over the intercom
voice: Ziggy is nervous, insinuating, and ingratiating in the approved Peter Lorre-inspired voice; Ernie is terse, working-class, and physically confident.

entries.text: The intercom crackles and you overhear a conversation:
I'm telling you, pal, you're not supposed to be down here.
Nothing personal, my friend, but Archie said I could look the place over.
He didn't say anything to me. Neither did Mr. Heimlich, and he's chief of security.
Easy, my friend. There's no reason to get excited. You can trust me.
I trust you about as far as I can throw you.
Please, my friend--there's no need for physical violence.
You've got ten seconds to get out of my sight.
Such a temper. But I had finished my little inspection anyway. Until next time.
Not if I can help it.
